allot.subject: Press Release
allot.text: Press Release on Rs. 161 Crore Equity Issuance pursuant to Warrant Conversion

allot.subject: Conversion
allot.text: Parag Milk Foods Limited has informed the Exchange about Conversion of 90,00,000 Share Warrants and Allotment of equal number of Equity Shares of the Company to warrant holders pursuant to exercise of right for conversion of warrants into equity shares.

allot.subject: Allotment of Securities
allot.text: Parag Milk Foods Limited has informed the Exchange regarding allotment of Equity Shares to ESOP Trust

allot.subject: Outcome of Board Meeting
allot.text: Parag Milk Foods Limited has informed the Exchange regarding Board meeting held on May 07, 2026, for, inter-alia, approval of Audited Financial Results FY 25-26, recommendation of dividend and allotment of equity shares to ESOP Trust

allot.subject: Updates
allot.text: Parag Milk Foods Limited has informed the Exchange regarding transfer of equity shares of the Company by ESOP Trust to Stock Option Grantee

allot.subject: Allotment of Securities
allot.text: Parag Milk Foods Limited has informed the Exchange regarding allotment of 90,00,000 convertible share warrants pursuant to preferential issue at its meeting held on May 23, 2025

allot.subject: Updates
allot.text: Parag Milk Foods Limited has informed the exchange about clarification on NSE queries in connection with issuance of convertible share warrants on preferential basis

allot.subject: Press Release
